text.p: Typhoon Nestor has passed between Iwo Jima and Chichi Jima in the northern Bonin Islands, producing heavy rain and strong wind. Nestor has top winds of 120 mph and is near 27n/142e, moving northeast at 11 mph. It will steadily weaken and accelerate out to the northeast into open water during the next 24-36 hours, well southeast of Japan, threatening only shipping. Conditions will rapidly improve in the northern Bonin Islands.

Tropical Cyclone Keli, with 120 mph winds, is well northeast of Fiji near 15s/175w, moving southeast at 15 mph. Keli will likely become extratropical as it tracks south of Samoa during this weekend. It is only a threat to shipping.
There are no further statements at this time.
